description: Activity system must track each task execution individually with task-level lifecycle logs (task start, task complete) and aggregate them into the parent activity record with task count, duration, and cost per task

components.currentBehavior: Emits 'Task starting:' log at line 2348 with taskId, description, activityId, subagent, dependencies. Emits 'Task completed:' log at line 2511 with taskId, description, activityId, attempts, duration, cost, usedTrailblazing, success. Tracks task results in taskResults array with status, attempts, duration, cost per task.
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - specification is SATISFIED

components.currentBehavior: Aggregates task-level session data into activity.executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned array. Each entry contains: sessionID, taskId, agentType, startTime, endTime, messageCount, toolCallCount. Also tracks individual tool calls in executionEvidence.toolCalls array.
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - specification is SATISFIED
components.gap: None - executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned provides per-task details as required

components.currentBehavior: Defines executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned schema with: sessionID (string), taskId (string), agentType (string), startTime (number), endTime (number), messageCount (number), toolCallCount (number). Also includes toolCalls array for individual tool tracking.
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - specification is SATISFIED
components.gap: None - schema provides all required fields

components.currentBehavior: Maintains in-memory taskResults array during execution with: taskId, status (in_progress/completed/failed), attempts, duration, cost. Updates via onStatusUpdate callback for live progress tracking.
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current - specification is SATISFIED
components.gap: None - taskResults provides task count, duration, and cost per task

dataFlow.summary: Task execution → log.info('Task starting') → execute task → accumulate metrics (cost, duration, tokens) → log.info('Task completed') → store in taskResults array → aggregate into activity.executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned → persist to Activity.Info record

entryPoints.trigger: Activity tool invocation from LLM or direct API call

transformations.output: Task starting log with taskId, description, metadata
Task result with success, cost, duration, tokens
Task completed log with metrics + taskResults array entry

validationPoints.expected: log.info('Task completed: ${taskId}') with duration, cost, attempts
taskResults array with taskId, status, attempts, duration, cost

currentStateVsDesired.summary:
The specification is FULLY SATISFIED by the current implementation. All required behaviors exist:

1. ✅ Task-level lifecycle logs emit 'Task starting:' and 'Task completed:' with taskId, description, duration, cost
2. ✅ Task execution metrics tracked in taskResults array with per-task details
3. ✅ Activity record aggregates all task metrics in executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned
4. ✅ Each task session includes: sessionID, taskId, agentType, startTime, endTime, messageCount, toolCallCount
5. ✅ Validation harness exists to verify lifecycle logging (activity-lifecycle-logging-harness.ts)

No gaps identified. Implementation is specification-compliant.
recommendations: Consider adding task duration/cost to executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned (currently in taskResults but not persisted per-session)
Add end-to-end test executing a 7-task activity and validating all lifecycle logs appear
Document the dual tracking mechanism (taskResults in-memory + executionEvidence persisted)

taskStartLog.code:
log.info(`Task starting: ${task.id}`, {
  taskId: task.id,
  description: task.description,
  activityId: _activity.id,
  subagent: task.subagent,
  dependencies: task.dependencies,
})

taskCompleteLog.code:
log.info(`Task completed: ${taskId}`, {
  taskId,
  description: task.description,
  activityId: _activity.id,
  attempts: result.attempts,
  duration: result.duration,
  durationSeconds: Math.round(result.duration / 1000),
  cost: result.cost,
  costFormatted: `$${result.cost.toFixed(4)}`,
  usedTrailblazing: result.attempts > 1,
  success: result.success,
})

taskResultsTracking.code:
taskResults[taskIndex] = {
  taskId,
  status: result.success ? "completed" : "failed",
  attempts: result.attempts,
  duration: result.duration,
  cost: result.cost,
}

executionEvidenceAggregation.code:
_activity.executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned.push({
  sessionID: subsessionID,
  taskId,
  agentType: task.subagent,
  startTime,
  endTime: Date.now(),
  messageCount: await getSessionMessageCount(subsessionID),
  toolCallCount: await getSessionToolCallCount(subsessionID),
})

testStrategy.approach: Execute a multi-task activity (7 tasks) and validate lifecycle logging
steps: 4. Verify 'Task completed:' log appears 7 times (or fewer if failures)
5. Verify activity record has executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned with 7 entries
6. Verify each entry has taskId, duration, cost, messageCount, toolCallCount
